mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_info (origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, category, uploader_id, create_time, status, frozen, download_count) VALUES (#{originName}, #{storeName}, #{filePath}, #{ext}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{category}, #{uploaderId}, #{createTime}, #{status}, #{frozen}, #{downloadCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, category, uploader_id, create_time, status, frozen, download_count FROM file_info WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, origin_name, store_name, file_path, ext, file_size, content_type, category, uploader_id, create_time, status, frozen, download_count FROM file_info WHERE uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE file_info SET frozen = #{frozen} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE file_info SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE file_info SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
